decisions.reason: The source decision adds an accuracy rule for the Home Page Top Referrals statistic. The separate leaderboard already has its own referral-count accuracy requirement and same-message evidence, so its state remains unchanged.
Accuracy of the Home Page Top Referrals statistic does not change which referral, ticket, and prize data the user dashboard must display.
The source decision concerns the Home Page Top Referrals statistic, not reward values displayed for an individual NFT.
The dashboard's owned-NFT listing behavior is unaffected by the requirement that Home Page Top Referrals match actual referral activity.
The source decision does not change the NFT metadata ticket counters or other reward attributes.
Referral-stat accuracy on the Home Page does not alter NFT image, cover, wallet, or product-view presentation requirements.
The source decision does not affect metadata or image endpoint resolution.
The About page's descriptive copy remains valid unchanged; requiring a live Home Page referral statistic to be accurate does not entail a copy revision.
The Home Page referral-stat accuracy rule does not change email verification, magic-link authentication, or dashboard access behavior.
The Mission page's leaderboard and referral descriptions are only incidental overlap and require no change from the Home Page statistic decision.
The source decision affects a referral statistic, not landing-page book-cover placement, sizing, cropping, or visibility.
Requiring Home Page Top Referrals to match actual activity does not change how fiat buyers access commissions, tickets, prizes, or their provisioned wallet.
